mapper.insert: INSERT INTO call_logs (request_id, key_id, model_alias, deployment_model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, cost, latency_ms, status, error_type, tenant_id, created_at) VALUES (#{requestId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{keyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{modelAlias,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deploymentModel,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{promptTokens,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{completionTokens,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{totalTokens,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{cost,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{latencyMs,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{status,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{errorType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tenantId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select: SELECT id, request_id, key_id, model_alias, deployment_model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, cost, latency_ms, status, error_type, tenant_id, created_at FROM call_logs WHERE request_id = #{requestId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
